meta.note: A ₹50,000 paper-trading experiment that BOOKS the 5 fresh multibaggers now and marks them to market as the months pass. It reports REALIZED P&L vs a Nifty Smallcap benchmark — it does NOT predict a future number. Weights are conviction-weighted: weight_i = composite_i / Σcomposite (composites computed by assets/scoring.js from data/candidates.json), then shares_i = floor(50000·weight_i / buyPrice_i), remainder → cash. Buy prices are the provisional CMP at screen date (13 Jun 2026); the GitHub Actions pipeline refreshes currentPrice and the benchmark level so the book becomes live and self-updating. The 6-month review date is 2026-12-13. Not financial advice.
meta.methodNote: weight_i = composite_i / Σcomposite ; shares_i = floor(startingCapital · weight_i / buyPrice_i) ; cash = startingCapital − Σ invested. Σcomposite = 360 across the 5 picks (ELECON 79, SKYGOLD 78, SKIPPER 76, TIMETECHNO 65, CYIENTDLM 62).

holdings.name: Elecon Engineering Co. Ltd
holdings.thesis: Debt-free industrial-gears leader (~25% ROCE) compounding on the power/mining/cement/defence capex cycle.
holdings.invalidation: Order book stalling 2+ quarters, OPM −300bps for two quarters, debt-funded M&A (D/E > 0.5), ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

holdings.name: Skipper Ltd
holdings.thesis: Power T&D tower/EPC play on the grid-capex super-cycle; ROIC ~31%, no pledge, Q4 PAT +63%.
holdings.invalidation: Order book stalling 2+ quarters, OCF negative, D/E above 1.0, any promoter pledge, ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

holdings.name: Sky Gold & Diamonds Ltd
holdings.thesis: B2B gold-jewellery scaler on jewellery formalisation; ~30% ROCE, no pledge, deleveraging, sales +77%.
holdings.invalidation: Margin contraction, working capital/debt re-expanding, a large customer loss, OCF persistently negative, ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

holdings.name: Time Technoplast Ltd
holdings.thesis: Global #2 in composite cylinders + steady industrial packaging; cheap, debt-light, H2/CNG optionality.
holdings.invalidation: ROCE below 12%, debt/EBITDA above 2.0, composite growth stalling 2+ quarters, OCF negative, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

holdings.name: Cyient DLM Ltd
holdings.thesis: Pure-play high-reliability EMS riding India's electronics boom; record order book, book-to-bill ~1.46 (highest risk/upside).
holdings.invalidation: Book-to-bill below 1.0, ROCE not improving over 12-18 months, working capital ballooning, OCF persistently negative, ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

benchmark.name: Nifty Smallcap 250
benchmark.note: Provisional start level pending the first live fetch; the GitHub Actions pipeline refreshes currentLevel (and re-baselines startLevel on the first run while startProvisional is true) so the benchmark return is real and dated.
